322	beings. This is what is meant by "all the life of this world": better one hour
323	of spiritual pleasure in the World to Come than all the life of this world.
324	"Korat ruach" is when you haven't yet entered Gan Eden, only a little
325	whiff from outside of what is happening there
326	inside. In Jerusalem there is Angel bakery. Whoever walks
327	by the bakery usually walks more slowly.
328	How pleasant it is there. That is called "korat ruach": better one hour
329	of spiritual pleasure in the World to Come than all the life of this world.
330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What is
331	the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of imagination. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with our eyes. But the
334	truth is that matter is a kind of imagination.
335	Even in science they are beginning to understand this. They know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, which are tiny particles
337	all packed one next to
338	the other. On the tip of a pin, how many atoms are there in the finest
339	point? How many atoms are there? You have to write the number
340	three and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the tip of a pin. And what is every atom made of?
342	An inner nucleus and electrons that spin around it
343	at speed, and they create the illusion of a shell. Like
344	a fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disc. The disc is an illusion. It
346	looks solid, like an atom, but it is not solid, it is only
347	the speed. Electrons move at speed
348	and create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	upon billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	moving? What would happen? The whole universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the real matter of the entire planet
354	Earth could fit in a matchbox. That is the real matter
355	that exists; all the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of... Since matter is imagination, say the sages
357	of Kabbalah, the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
358	imagination. In the material world, when a person enjoys, it is a kind of
359	imagination. But he enjoys because it suits matter.
